versions.changelog:
xigua-video-hot-trend 0.1.0

- Initial release of the xigua-video-hot-trend skill.
- Provides summaries and analysis for Xigua Video’s public videos, short drama pages, and topics.
- Supports extraction of video/short drama metadata, updates, and topic statistics based on public web pages.
- Focuses on lightweight, browser-assisted workflows without download or bulk collection.
- Ensures compliance with platform rules; only uses information from public pages.
